macros.name: callidentifier
macros.doc: This macro takes as its sole argument the identifier of the call to which the proposal is being submitted, which will be printed in the page header.

macros.name: callname
macros.doc: This macro takes as its sole argument the official natural-language description of the call to which the proposal is being submitted. It will be printed in the page header.

macros.name: calltopic
macros.doc: This macro takes as its sole argument the identifier of the specific topic within the call to which the proposal is being submitted.

macros.name: closetag
macros.doc: The \opentag and \closetag macros are used to emit the tags at the appropriate places in the proposal, and so should be left in their original positions in the skeleton proposal.

macros.name: criticalrisk
macros.doc: This macro declares a critical risk for the project.

macros.name: deliverable
macros.doc: This macro declares a deliverable for the most recently declared work package.

macros.name: equipmentcost
macros.doc: This macro declares an equipment cost (for the “Purchase costs” tables).

macros.name: inkindcontribution
macros.doc: This macro declares an in-kind contribution.

macros.name: makecriticalriskstable
macros.doc: This macro emits the table of critical risks, using the data from the \criticalrisk macros.

macros.name: makedeliverablestable
macros.doc: This macro emits the table of deliverables, using the data from the \deliverable macros.

macros.name: makeequipmentcoststable
macros.doc: This macro emits the tables of equipment (i.e., purchase) costs, using the data from the \equipmentcost macros.

macros.name: makeinkindcontributionstable
macros.doc: This macro emits the tables of in-kind contributions, using the data from the \inkindcontribution macros.

macros.name: makeothercoststable
macros.doc: This macro emits the tables of “other” costs, using the data from the \othercost macros.

macros.name: makeparticipantstable
macros.doc: This macro emits the table of participants using the data from the \participant macro.

macros.name: makestaffefforttable
macros.doc: This macro emits the summary of staff effort table, using the data from the \staffeffort macros.

macros.name: makesubcontractingcoststable
macros.doc: This macro emits the tables of subcontracting costs, using the data from the \subcontractingcost macros.

macros.name: milestone
macros.doc: This macro declares a project milestone.

macros.name: opentag
macros.doc: The \opentag and \closetag macros are used to emit the tags at the appropriate places in the proposal, and so should be left in their original positions in the skeleton proposal.

macros.name: othercost
macros.doc: This macro declares an “other” cost (i.e., in the “other costs” category).

macros.name: purchasecost
macros.doc: This macro declares the purchase costs for a participant.

macros.name: subcontractingcost
macros.doc: This macro declares a subcontracting cost.

macros.name: task
macros.doc: This macro typesets basic information about a work package task.

macros.name: templateversion
macros.doc: This macro sets the version of the official Part B template the proposal should use.

macros.name: workpackage
macros.doc: This macro declares a work package, and takes five mandatory arguments: a unique identifier (used only internally by heria for cross-referencing purposes), the work package title, the short name of the lead participant (as specified in the corresponding \participant macro), the numeric starting month (measured from the start of the project), and the numeric ending month.

envs.name: descriptionofwork
envs.doc: This environment typesets a box where you can describe the work program of the most recently declared work package.

envs.name: objectives
envs.doc: This environment typesets a box containing an enumerated list of objectives for the most recently declared work package.

envs.name: SidewaysFigure
envs.doc: SidewaysFigure puts its contents in a floating figure, which avoids wasting space when the material preceding the summary tableau doesn’t end at the bottom of a page.

envs.name: summarybox
envs.doc: Each summarybox environment typesets a shaded box headed by its mandatory argument.
